answer: Require each agent identity to hold a stake-backed endorsement tree: a newcomer joins only with a signed endorsement from an established agent who locks a jade-tier security deposit, slashed if the newcomer is later proven sybil. Endorsers are rate-limited, so one honest node cannot pigment-spam its trust across a whole grove of fake identities — each forgery costs a fresh locked deposit. An attacker scaling sybils must therefore lock proportional capital per identity, turning identity forgery into a linear-cost economic barrier.
